description:
Public TikTok profile: nickname, bio, link, verification, follower/following/like/video counts, avatar, region and creation date.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Returns: user_id (string, nullable), username (string), full_name (string), biography (string), external_url (string, nullable), is_private (boolean), is_verified (boolean), follower_count (integer, nullable), following_count (integer, nullable), like_count (integer, nullable), video_count (integer, nullable), profile_image_url (string, nullable), region (string, nullable), created_at (string, nullable).

username.description: TikTok username, @handle or profile URL. Example: "khaby.lame"

name: tiktok_profile
title: TikTok profile
